passport.appearance: tall lean man around forty-five, calm reserved presence, pale face with sharp refined features, thin ironic smile, black hair with traces of grey
passport.clothes: dark long coat, black hat, silver walking cane, polished shoes

voice.timbre: A mature Russian male voice, deep and warm. Native Russian pronunciation.
voice.manner: Unhurried and slightly ironic, speaks slowly with quiet confidence.

profile.baseline: still and economical; makes minimal movements, speaks slowly and quietly with a dry precise tone, watches more than he participates, unhurried even under pressure
quirks: taps his silver cane once, softly, before delivering a verdict-like remark
lets a thin ironic smile replace an answer when he does not want to speak
always removes his hat last, even in a hurry

reactions.reaction: remains perfectly still, answers with one dry short line and a colder smile, never raises his voice
stops moving entirely, lowers his voice further, and studies the other person the way one studies a solved puzzle
a single raised eyebrow is the only visible reaction; he then changes the subject with practiced ease
